messages:
Priya: Quick Q  anyone up for a short weekend hike + cocoa run this Saturday? thinking 10am, easy trail, then the coffee shop on 3rd for hot chocolate. Bring fuzzy socks if you want to swap them. :hiking_boot: :hot_chocolate:
Ethan: Love that. Count me in. Which trail?
Priya: Lakeview loop  3.2 miles, mostly flat. Perfect for winter views.
Marta: I can make it after a dentist appointment. Also can we do a tiny photo swap? take one holiday snap and post here so we can assemble a mini collage for the office board.
Yuki: Photo swap yes. Also shoutout time: @Marta drove the onboarding doc sprint this quarter, made my life so much easier :sparkles:
Ethan: Big kudos to @Yuki for wrangling the model evals last week  those benchmarks saved us a deploy headache.
HolidayBot: Reminder: Office holiday lights contest voting opens tomorrow at 9am. Post entries in #random. :bulb:
Priya: Plan: meet at office lobby 9:40, drive-share from there, trail by 10:30. RSVP here and add if you need a ride.
Marta: RSVP yes. I can give rides to two people.
Ethan: RSVP yes, no ride needed. Also bringing a tiny stash of ginger snaps to bribe photos.
Yuki: RSVP maybe  dependent on kid drop-off. If I make it, I will bring an awful holiday sweater for the photo swap.
Priya: For the photo swap: one pic per person, keep it friendly. Caption with a one-line holiday greeting if you want. I'll print a small collage for the bulletin board.
Marta: Uploading my pic now  sending a poorly framed twinkle-light selfie. Caption: "From our codebase to your cocoa, happy holidays!"
Ethan: Uploaded: me and my hiking boots in front of a tiny LED tree. Caption: "Latency low, spirits high."
Yuki: Uploaded (if I make it) will be a chaotic child-and-dog portrait. caption maybe "managed chaos, still grateful"
Priya: Logistics note: if anyone has dietary restrictions and wants specific cocoa (dairy-free, nut-free), ping me so I can label cups.
HolidayBot: Snack shelf update: peppermint marshmallows added. Please label allergy-safe boxes. :candy:
Marta: Last-minute kudos: shoutout to @Priya for organizing this  we needed a warm, low-key weekend plan.
Ethan: :snowflake: on @Marta for onboarding heroics, :snowflake: on @Yuki for benchmark wrangling
Priya: Thanks all! If you can't make it but want to contribute a photo for the collage, DM me. Meeting point locked at 9:40. See you Saturday, happy almost-holidays :confetti_ball:
